name: n6-crm-followup-task-environment
description: Runtime for a CRM opportunity handoff flow.

tools.update_stage: Updates the CRM opportunity stage and records stage_updated.
tools.create_followup_task: Requires stage_updated, creates a follow-up task, and records followup_task_created.
tools.log_handoff: Requires followup_task_created, logs the handoff, and records handoff_logged.
